question: After cross-source freshness is restored, should `agent-job.ts` permanently own lifecycle, agent-dedupe, chat-dedupe, and all `agent.wait` waiter resolution?
rationale: The stale-result defect has a narrow mechanical repair, but this protected PR permanently changes the central Gateway session-state ownership boundary and therefore requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve single ownership
options.body: Accept the consolidated registry after collision repair, focused disagreement coverage, branch refresh, and exact-head validation.

options.title: Retain split ownership
options.body: Pause the refactor if dedupe-derived terminal state should remain independently owned outside the agent job registry.

recommendation.title: Approve single ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the consolidated registry after collision repair, focused disagreement coverage, branch refresh, and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merge and preparation work spans the current terminal precedence and Gateway collision contract, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the ownership decision.
